Every reserve moved late, every counterattack mounted a week after the moment for it, every liaison officer riding between two staffs who each had the authority to say no.0MANPOWER -5MUNITIONS +4MORALE Speculative counterfactualSpeculative. Unity of command did not win the war. It shortened it, and the difference is measured in the only currency that has been counted here. What actually happened: The unified command moved reserves between the British and French sectors through the spring and summer, and the autumn offensives were planned as a single design, which the national commanders in this ending do not have. The war ended in November 1918, a year before the Allies' own planners expected it to. Some 1.4 million French soldiers had been killed by the end of it.
